prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input: Image1 is the entire original Silent Storm opaque original diffuse map enlarged exactly8x nearest-neighbor solely to reveal source shape.
Request: Faithful HD material reconstruction; return the complete same square1:1 flat opaque UV atlas only.
Source inventory: Complete square original console UI background diffuse, a dark muted brown/gray plain finely mottled surface. Preserve original broad mottling and existing very faint diagonal grain at identical pattern scale and direction; no new weave, crosshatch, scratches, creases, framed panels, symbols, stars, objects or edge ornament. This is a repeating flat UI background, so retain original edge continuation and uniform fine material character. There is no text drawn within this texture; text remains separate UI controls.
UV/content lock: Every contour, island, gap, seam, baked fold/shadow, mark and existing detail stays at exact normalized coordinates with identical count, shape and scale. No crop, zoom, margins, rotation, repacking or bbox registration. Preserve all source materials and opaque black padding. Do not infer extra objects from texture fragments.
Material detail: Fine smooth irregular non-repeating material grain only, at original surface scale. No visible crosshatch, herringbone, weave, decorative loops or regular diagonal texture pattern at full output size. Plain felt/cloth/leather and painted metal must remain plain. No curled, swirling, embossed, decorative, ornamental or repeating patterns, no ornamental strokes at any scale. Smooth original compression blocks without retaining block grids or converting them into geometric seams. Preserve exact original mark/detail counts, pitch, phase and silhouettes, including tiny glints. Do not add folds or surface marks. Original blank padding remains plain. Keep source muted palette/dark exposure, later brightness matched numerically.
Avoid: New hardware, screws, rivets, buttons, holes, eyelets, lacing, stripes, ribs, stitching, patches, damage, labels, letters, logos, insignia or any invented recognizable component. No rendered item, perspective, scene or artistic redesign. Preserve exact source detail cadence, UV layout and material identity.
reference_recipe: Exact original entire canvas8x nearest sourceguide; no crop/padding/bbox/artistic edits. Raw entire-canvas normalized to logical4x Lanczos only, source alpha/numeric brightness handled by root.
